# Candemkey

> Candemkey is a privacy-first AI keyboard for iOS and Android, created by Candemsoft. It integrates on-device generative AI directly into your mobile keyboard across every app (messaging, email, social media, notes).

## Core Capabilities
- **Text Enhancement**: Fix typos, grammar, and syntax instantly with one tap on the ✦ AI button.
- **Tone Adjustment**: Formalize professional messages, adopt a friendly casual tone, summarize long thoughts, or lengthen brief replies.
- **Translation**: Translate text inline between Turkish, English, and Spanish without switching apps.
- **Custom Prompts & Commands**: Write custom instructions directly from the keyboard command line.
- **Privacy & Safety**: Keystrokes and typing history are never logged or stored on Candemsoft servers. AI processing occurs only when explicitly triggered by the user on the selected text.

## Supported Platforms & Layouts
- **Platforms**: iOS (with optional Full Access for AI features) & Android.
- **Keyboard Layouts**: Turkish Q, English QWERTY, Spanish QWERTY.
- **Languages**: Turkish (tr), English (en), Spanish (es).
